summary: Real Mutter virtual-seat controls verify canonical card snapshots, radio/text submissions, held receipts, decline/cancel, lost acknowledgement reconnect, stale and foreign snapshot rejection, conversation isolation, canonical secure links and keyboard dismissal without application windows.

regression.rootCause: Card replacement destroys the focused entry; canonical conversation refresh disables the focused composer and GNOME falls back to MetaStage. The old refresh logic restored focus only when the target was null.
regression.fix: Return focus to the stable composer when replacing its focused card subtree; treat the stage fallback as unowned focus after canonical history completes, while preserving another real actor's focus.
regression.detectorFailure: Earlier native chat tests did not exercise card answer-field replacement followed by conversation refresh and Escape.
regression.guard: Immediate native focus assertions after answer replacement and conversation refresh, plus real-seat Escape verifies panel removal and local subscription cancellation.

evidence.visualReadback: Verified readable styled question, exact text input and visible Submit/Decline/Cancel, within Shell actors.
